description:
National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) is seeking an A&E firm to provide Title I, II, and III design services for modifications to the existing Optimization & Controls Lab (OCL) inside NLR’s Energy Systems Integration Facility (ESIF) at our South Table Mountain Campus located in Golden, CO. The resulting IFC design package will have two (2) primary components: 

 
	 Automate a roof ventilation system and the existing laboratory roll-up doors to open during a fire. 
	 Provide a manual extraction system capable of removing a burning Electric Vehicle (EV) from the OCL bay through the roll-up doors to the adjacent outdoor lot.
